title: byte ranges are (offset, length) indices into caller's buffer, not stored slices
description: ParsedPart.header_range and body_range are (usize, usize) tuples — offset and length into the caller's original &[u8]. The crate never stores the raw message bytes internally. A future contributor might suggest storing Arc<Vec<u8>> or slices in ParsedPart to avoid the caller needing to pass raw bytes to decode_body_value. That would be wrong for three reasons: (1) it would introduce lifetime parameters or reference-counted overhead into the public types; (2) it would prevent Serialize+Deserialize from working without a custom impl; (3) byte-range indexing is the correct model for lazy blob fetch — the caller can store the parsed tree and fetch bodies on demand from object storage without re-parsing.
